scope: Decoded CSV analysis only; no COMSOL run; no full protocol/sweep.
limitations: Min/max are COMSOL evaluations at Lagrange order 5 sampling points, not a proof over every continuum point.
All stored rows are checked for physical identities and bounds; pairwise mesh/time comparisons use only exact 0..5 integer seconds.
Numerical identity tolerances are 1e-8 V and 1e-10 normalized concentration; Li tolerance is 1e-6 relative. These are analysis acceptance criteria, not experimental validation.
Physical checks do not establish complete protocol behavior, cutoff correctness, mesh/time convergence, or 4.25 V equilibrium feasibility.
